note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground in two wooded loops at the south end of Washburn Lake, with a dock, boat access and swimming. Groomed cross-country ski trails nearby. Managed by Cuyuna Country State Recreation Area. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00033 read: 31 primitive sites, vault toilets, drinking water mid-May to mid-October, managed by Cuyuna Country SRA. First come with same-day online pay, $17 tax included (phone-reservation claim was wrong). Lakefront -> lakeview proposed; pin is in the lake; phone and website fixes.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed). The stored evidence ('drive-in sites with individual docks at the W shore of Lake Washburn, pads within ~20-30m of waterline') was read at the stored pin, which is in the lake; the docked lots on that west shore (around 46.8520,-93.9805) are private cabins, not the campground. The campground is two loops south of the shore (centred about 46.8500,-93.9787). On imagery the north loop's clearing (about 46.8508,-93.9788) is 30-50 m from the reed/marsh edge behind a continuous band of trees, open water further out; no pad reaches open shore. The only open ground on the water is the day-use point to the east (about 46.8512,-93.9772). No site map numbers the sites, so no lakefront site can be named. Not an --AWH value.
PIN MOVE: stored 46.8518,-93.9788 is in Washburn Lake, about 225 m north of the campground. Suggest the DNR facility point 46.849777,-93.978481 (between the two loops).

PHONE: stored 866-857-2757 is the DNR reservation line, and individual state forest sites cannot be reserved. The DNR facility lists the manager, Cuyuna Country State Recreation Area, 218-772-3690. Suggest 866-857-2757 -> 218-772-3690.
